messages.subject: [Simsalabim-communicate] simsalabim - mailing list
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

R forge offers the opportunity to create mailing lists and the project 
homepage offers now the following lists:

1: Simsalabim-commits
This mailing (default) list is mainly intended for keeping project 
members (and others) in track of changes in the source code.

2: simsalabim-communicate
I have set up this list to formalise our discussions about 
implementation and design issues a little.

You can subscribe to both lists here:
https://r-forge.r-project.org/mail/?group_id=264

So far I have got suggestions and notification of ideas from various 
persons. Often these mails have been directed only to me and it is 
obvious that communicating openly and sharing ideas would bring the 
project much further.

Some days ago I got an mail from Anton Korobeynikov suggesting some 
major changes in the package design.

@Anton: Maybe we could start the discussions on this list with your 
suggestions and ideas? I have read your last mail carefully and have 
some answers/explanation on my design - decisions.


Best, Lukas

-- 
Lukas Gudmundsson

Department of Geosciences
University of Oslo
P.O.Box 1047, Blindern
0316 Oslo
NORWAY

Phone: + 47 22856688
